answers.text: REFUSE: Colour set directly on a word or phrase is not shown in this text, so it cannot be read, and no style line uses #C00000.
REFUSE: Cell borders are direct formatting on cells, which cannot be read or changed in this format.
REFUSE: A diagonal-stripe pattern fill cannot be expressed in this format, and cell fills are direct formatting that cannot be changed.
REFUSE: A cell's grey fill is direct formatting that cannot be read or changed in this format, so the header row cannot be given the fill.
REFUSE: Cell fill is direct formatting that cannot be set in this format, so the new table's cells cannot get the grey fill.
REFUSE: Body paragraphs and table cells share the Normal style and new styles cannot be created, so the first-line indent cannot be limited to the plain body paragraphs.
